name: roof-hip
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE INDIVIDUAL CORNER HIP ROOF BLOCK for a modular stone temple game kit. Square footprint 2m x 2m, flat bottom, height 1.1m at the inward/rear corner and only 0.25m at the two outward/front edges. Two broad sloping triangular limestone roof planes meet along the diagonal from the low outside corner to the high inside corner. It is the outside corner piece of a pyramidal roof, designed to join straight wedge-shaped roof blocks on both sides. Strong softened bevels and one small chipped outside corner, no fine ornament or noise. Muted warm limestone/sage grey with light worn bevels and darker cool sides, restrained painterly stone texture, tiny moss only at one seam. The entire isolated thick 3D block shown in three-quarter orthographic view on plain pale grey, no ground plane, no other objects, no whole roof or building, no text or watermark. A single useful geometric building module, full silhouette in frame.
